p3.query: How does ColBERT MaxSim aggregate query-document token similarities into a document relevance score?
p3.rewritten_query: ColBERT MaxSim aggregation query-document token similarities document relevance score late interaction
p3.hypothetical_document: ColBERT computes a relevance score by applying a MaxSim operation over query-document token similarities. For each query token, it takes the maximum similarity across all document tokens, then sums these maximum values to aggregate the per-token matches into a single document relevance score.
